reason: README shows run_generator.py generating images from a downloadable pretrained FFHQ pickle, feasible on CPU if the CUDA custom ops fall back to the reference implementation.
demo: Using pre-trained networks: python run_generator.py generate-images --network=gdrive:networks/stylegan2-ffhq-config-f.pkl --seeds=66,230 --truncation-psi=1.0
goal: Make `python run_generator.py generate-images --network=gdrive:networks/stylegan2-ffhq-config-f.pkl --seeds=66,230 --truncation-psi=1.0 --result-dir=<dir>` run on a CPU-only machine (no GPU, no nvcc), producing seed0066.png and seed0230.png in a run subdirectory of <dir>. The repo needs TensorFlow 1.x and its custom CUDA ops (fused_bias_act, upfirdn_2d) default to impl='cuda', so a CPU-compatible path must be arranged. The network pickle is downloaded from nvlabs-fi-cdn.nvidia.com.
check: The hidden test runs the generate-images command with seeds 66 and 230 and verifies two valid 1024x1024 RGB PNG images were produced that are not blank.
